Resolves #21863

Related: #21346

Adds the built-in `dueDate` card-item renderer (`src/board/CardItems.mjs`), wires `{type: 'dueDate'}` into `Neo.board.Container#cardItems_` (`src/board/Container.mjs:68`), and extracts `Neo.util.Date.formatWall` (`src/util/Date.mjs`, with `TimeAxisHeader.formatWall` delegating to it) alongside `DateUtil.convertToyyyymmdd` so saving a **Due date** in `Neo.board.CardEditor` renders a semantic `<time class="neo-board-card-due-date" datetime="YYYY-MM-DD">` badge (`Due <Mon D>` by default, UTC-pinned so calendar dates never roll over across timezones) while dateless cards emit zero extra DOM nodes.

Evidence: L3 (258/258 `unit/util/Date` + `unit/timeline` + `unit/board` tests including `TZ=America/Los_Angeles`, local baseline guards, Neural Link whitebox E2E `BasicNL.spec.mjs` + `CardDesigns.spec.mjs` + `CardEditor.spec.mjs` + `SwimlanesNL.spec.mjs`, and `1440×900` dark/light browser captures with two blinded cold-look reads) -> L3 required (AC-1 through AC-5).

- **Shared `Neo.util.Date.formatWall` & `DateUtil.convertToyyyymmdd` (`d55e7d3f2d`):** Moved `formatWall(locale, options, wall, wallEnd)` and its cached `Intl.DateTimeFormat` `Map` from `src/timeline/TimeAxisHeader.mjs` into `src/util/Date.mjs` (keeping `TimeAxisHeader.formatWall` as a one-line delegate) and wired `CardItems.mjs` to call `DateUtil.convertToyyyymmdd` and `DateUtil.formatWall` directly (`#21863` Contract Ledger updated in sync).
- Ticket intake (`self-authored-carve.md` Stage 2 + §1.9.6: `Prescription checked: src/board/CardItems.mjs + src/board/Container.mjs — owns the concern`; `src/core/Base.mjs`, `src/Neo.mjs`, `src/state/Provider.mjs` read) sharpened the CSS token and `Due` prefix after Round-1 cold-look inspection (`update_issue_body` synced before commit). `agent-preflight`: not hosted in `neomjs/neo`; all local `pr-baseline.yml` guards ran with exit 0.

Frame critique: Round-1 cold reader flagged two real issues on an initial bare-date draft (`Dec 15` without `Due` was ambiguous vs start/completed dates and read close to tag pills in dark mode, and stacking `dueDate` above `avatars` added a 4th vertical row on `In progress` / `Done` cards); both were fixed on-branch via `item.prefix ?? 'Due'` (`Due Dec 15`), `--neo-board-card-hover-border-color` 1px outline, and `.neo-board-card-due-date + .neo-board-card-avatars` sharing one footer row. Round-2 cold reader noted that dateless cards keep `avatars` bottom-left while dated cards place `Due <date>` left and `avatars` right — kept intentionally so dateless cards and published `neomjs/pages` board covers remain pixel-identical; pre-existing bottom-of-column scroll clipping and `examples/board/basic` grid column list (`Card`, `Status`, `Assignee`) are out of scope.

## Cold look

Two unprimed `research` (`Gemini 4 Hydrogen`) readers inspected the three frames cold (`read_file` on images only):
- **Reader 1 (`35a8695b`, initial draft):** Identified the new outlined date badges across 4 cards, flagged ambiguity without a `Due` prefix or icon, noted subtle dark-mode border contrast, and flagged wasted vertical space where `Nov 28` and `Dec 4` sat on a separate row above `E` / `A` avatars -> all three fixed before commit.
- **Reader 2 (`dc1eef67`, shipped head):** Confirmed `Due Dec 15` / `Due Nov 28` is self-explanatory at first glance without an icon, confirmed clean separation between lowercase filled tag pills and capitalized outlined `Due` rectangles, verified zero clipping or overlap inside any card in Dark and Light themes, and noted left-vs-right avatar placement between dateless and dated cards (dispositioned in `Frame critique:` above).
